name: CoA classes take the Zandalar Paragons of Power quests of their gear family (#8082)
contract: Report #8082: CoA characters are offered none of the Zandalar Tribe class quests on Yojamba Isle.

Quests 8062 (Zandalar Predator's Bracers, Hunter) and 8063 (Zandalar Madcap's Bracers, Rogue) from Falthir the Sightless (14905) allow one stock class each, and a single stock-class mask stays closed to CoA classes.
Neither quest has a minimum reputation, previous quest or condition, and both need level 58, so at level 60 only the class check decides.

Decision on #8082: a CoA class takes the quests of the stock class GetLegacyClassForCustomClass maps it to. A Ranger (Hunter family) takes 8062, a Barbarian (Rogue family) takes 8063 but not 8062, and a stock Hunter keeps 8062.

steps.label: A stock Hunter can take Predator's Bracers
A Ranger can take Predator's Bracers
A Barbarian can take Madcap's Bracers
A Barbarian cannot take the Hunter family's Predator's Bracers
